name: another happiness
source:
You see, once you reach my age, you start thinking a lot about things from when you were younger. Places you've been to...

people you knew.

And in your memories, everything's still exactly as it was back then, right? So...

...I wonder if I matched up to her memories of me.

[From [url=https://chiffon.itch.io/another-happiness]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你看，一旦你到了我这个年纪，你就会开始思考很多年轻时的事情。你去过的地方…

你认识的人。

而在你的记忆中，一切都还一如当初吧？所以…

……不知道我是否符合她对我的记忆。

[来自[url=https://chiffon.itch.io/another-happiness]itch.io[/url]]
